tob_tour.text: Welcome to Tobermory Distillery. Founded 1798, one of the oldest on the islands, and the only one with a view of the harbour from the warehouse.
It's made from barley, water and yeast. This time of year we're doing a peated run, a smoky one, and the smell gets into your jumper for a week.
The tour starts at ten sharp. The door's locked at ten past. Nobody has ever been let in late. Some have begged.

tob_mashman.text: I stir the mash. Hot water on malted barley, and the sugars come out. It smells like warm porridge. I eat a lot of porridge, for research.
